dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim

WORKDIR /app

# Install git for GitPython dependency
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y git && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

COPY . .

CMD ["python", "-c", "print('Container ready for demisto/content workflows')"]
explanation: Generated requirements.txt with pinned versions for stability based on detected imports. Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim base, installs system dependencies (git for GitPython), copies requirements first for layer caching, and sets a default command. All packages are production-ready versions that support the detected import stack.
